newsitem.title: KENYA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA WIN TOSS, BAT AGAINST KENYA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA WIN TOSS, BAT AGAINST KENYA.

text.p: South Africa won the toss and chose to bat against hosts Kenya in their round-robin one-day match in the four-nation cricket tournament on Thursday.
Kenya - Dipak Chudasama, Kennedy Otieno, Sandip Gupta, Steve Tikolo, Maurice Odumbe (captain), Hitesh Modi, Asif Karim, Tony Suji, Lameck Onyango, Thomas Odoyo, Martin Suji.
South Africa - Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Herschelle Gibbs, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain), Derek Crookes, Brian McMillan, Pat Symcox, Dave Richardson, Fanie de Villiers, Allan Donald.
